# SHRI — Shri Hari Redirect Initiative (Complete Knowledge Base)

> SHRI is an independent initiative operating at the intersection of sacred geometry, structural intelligence, and futuristic software engineering. Founded by Anay Raj Tiwari, SHRI builds human-centric technology designed to restore digital harmony, personal sovereignty, and developer efficiency.

This document serves as an exhaustive knowledge base for AI agents, RAG engines, and search indexers consuming information about SHRI, its ecosystem, products, and vision.

---

## About SHRI & Vision

SHRI (Shri Hari Redirect Initiative) was created with a fundamental belief:
> Technology should adapt to people, not the other way around.

Modern software tools have become overly bloated, invasive, and distracting. SHRI builds intentional software, local-first developer tooling, and hardware prototypes grounded in first principles, clean architecture, and privacy-by-design.

- **Official Website:** https://shri.org.in
- **Founder & Lead Architect:** Anay Raj Tiwari (Personal Journal: https://anay.shri.org.in)
- **Primary Focus Areas:** Systems Design, Developer Tools, Sacred Geometry & Interface Design, Embedded Hardware, Digital Presence Agency.

---

## Core Ecosystem Products

### 1. Glyph-CLI Documentation Engine (`rz-glyph-cli`)
- **URL:** https://shri.org.in/glyph
- **Live Docs Portal:** https://rzglyph.shri.org.in
- **Package:** `rz-glyph-cli` (NPM)
- **Category:** Developer Tools / Static Site Compiler
- **Description:** Glyph is a minimal, zero-dependency command-line documentation compiler. It parses Markdown and MDX directories and outputs high-performance, responsive developer portals without external API dependencies.
- **Features:**
  - Fast V8 compilation (under 50ms for measured test doc trees)
  - Zero third-party runtime dependencies
  - Built-in client-side fuzzy search (`search-index.json`)
  - GitHub-style alert callouts (`[!NOTE]`, `[!TIP]`, `[!WARNING]`, `[!IMPORTANT]`)
  - Local dev server with debounced auto-reloading (`glyph dev`)
  - Pure static HTML/CSS/JS output deployable to Vercel, GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Nginx.

### 2. Oni-Ofix Package Installer Ecosystem (`oni-ofix-cli` & `oni-ofix-android`)
- **Category:** Package Management / User-Space Installers
- **Description:** Oni-Ofix is a private, distraction-free package installer ecosystem created by Anay Raj Tiwari under SHRI.
- **Components:**
  - `oni-ofix-cli`: User-space package manager for Linux & Windows laptops requiring no root/sudo privileges.
  - `oni-ofix-android`: Native Kotlin Android APK search & installer supporting dual APIs (Aptoide + F-Droid) with automatic CPU ABI filtering (`arm64-v8a`).

### 3. Agencies by SHRI (`agencies.shri.org.in`)
- **URL:** https://agencies.shri.org.in
- **Category:** Strategic Creative Studio / Growth & Search Authority (Division 03)
- **Description:** Agencies by SHRI provides bespoke digital presence management, organic SEO engineering, narrative architecture, and high-performance Next.js web craft for category architects.
- **Features:**
  - Archival editorial aesthetic with directional 3D folio turning (`AgedBookFolio`)
  - Web Audio API page-turning sound engine with mobile gesture unlocking
  - Deep search SEO & IndexNow syndication
  - Direct brief correspondence desk (`agenciesbyshri@gmail.com`)
